column1: # Excel date formats that don't reduce to a 1-2-3 D1..D5 enum survive
# load → display via FormatKind::DateCustom — the original Excel
# pattern is preserved verbatim instead of being collapsed to (D1..D5)
# and re-rendered in 1-2-3's canonical UPPERCASE letter-month form.
# Layout on sheet A — every cell holds Lotus serial 45931 (= 2025-10-01)
#   A3  num_fmt = "mmm yyyy"    → "Oct 2025"    (was lossy-bucketed to D3)
# Default column width is 9. "01-Oct-2025" (A4) is 11 chars, so we
# widen column A to 12 before asserting on it.
# Widen column A to 12 so the 11-char "01-Oct-2025" renders in full.
# Each cell renders the Excel pattern verbatim — mixed-case month
# names, 4-digit year, original separator. The tag in parentheses is
# the closest 1-2-3 fit ("D1*" = "looks like D1 but custom").
